description: C4: CelestialBody.GetAtmoThermalStats / GetFullTemperature evaluated in FLIGHT (PhysProf-S on the KSC pad, Kerbin rotating frame) exactly as FlightIntegrator.CalculateSunBodyFlux builds its inputs: pos = body.GetWorldSurfacePosition(lat, lon, alt); scaledPos = ScaledSpace.LocalToScaledSpace(pos); d = sun.scaledBody.transform.position - scaledPos; sunVector = d / |d|; upAxis = FlightGlobals.getUpAxis(body, pos); sunDot = Dot(sunVector, upAxis). Grid: lat {-90,-60,-30,0,30,60,90} x lon {0,90,180,270} x alt {0, 10 km, 30 km, 0.9*atmosphereDepth (60 km for Mun)} for Kerbin, Eve, Duna, Laythe, Jool and Mun (no atmosphere: body-flux branch only), at UT0, UT0 + 0.25 and 0.5 Kerbin solar day, UT0 + 0.25 Kerbin year (Planetarium.SetUniversalTime then 2 physics frames). GetFullTemperature(pos) is recorded as returned: in 1.12.5 it returns the offset, not a temperature, and uses an unnormalised sun vector.

provenance.decimal_format: normalized from _hex by harness/captures/tools/normalize.py (harness ExactNumber.FormatFloat/FormatDouble on .NET Framework ToString G6..G9 / G15..G17)
